en: A black and white vintage postcard depicting a stone building with classical architectural elements, surrounded by ancient ruins and two prominent columns in the foreground. There are two people, an adult and a child, standing near the columns. The building has decorative reliefs above the windows. The bottom of the postcard contains printed text in both red and black, and there is handwritten script in the lower portion.
